title: Password Philosophy
description: Validate passwords against two different policy interpretations.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse each line with a regex to extract the two numbers, the character, and the password. Apply two different interpretations of the policy.

## Part 1

The two numbers define a range for how many times the character must appear in the password. Count occurrences and check if they fall within `[lo, hi]`.

## Part 2

The two numbers are 1-indexed positions. Exactly one of those positions must contain the specified character (XOR).
